rows.coder_note: Decision order step 1 (rule H): p002 and p004 give FinnGen version R12 (finngen_R12_N14_ACUTERENFAIL; 500,348 individuals), but p003 writes 'FinnGen R12 database (N=412,181)', a number given as the size of the release that is exactly the sample size of FinnGen R10; the two identifiers point to different rows. The 8,383 cases / 480,448 controls of p002 are endpoint counts and not a conflict.

Decision order step 1 (rules I3, C4, second case): p002 gives ebi-a-GCST90018790, inside the registered range GCST90018563-GCST90019002 of 'Sakaue 2021 BBJ (220 traits)', with 482,266 individuals, a count that row (up to 178,726) does not allow; the number is stated as the size of the GWAS itself, not a subset. The cited reference 21 (Sakaue 2021, DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00931-x) has three dictionary rows and the sentence gives no attribute that matches exactly one.

Decision order step 4 (rules D, E not met): p003 attributes the data to UKB-PPP with reference 18 (Sun 2023, DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6), a source with four dictionary rows; the only attributes are '54,219 European participants' and 2,940 proteins, and 54,219 equals no row's sample size, so no attribute matches exactly one row without contradiction (European alone would point to the discovery row, whose N is 34,557). Not coded to the closest release.
